offering_description.value: Leases freight railcars to shippers and railroads and manages fleets for railcar owners. It builds and sells freight railcars and replacement parts and provides maintenance and rail logistics services.

primary_products.value: Freight railcars including tank cars, covered hoppers and gondolas; railcar parts and components; rail logistics software

primary_services.value: Railcar leasing; fleet management; railcar maintenance and repair; rail shipment management; transloading

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial and agricultural shippers, freight railroads, railcar leasing companies and other fleet owners

end_markets.value: Freight rail transportation; chemicals and petroleum; agriculture and food; industrial manufacturing; construction materials

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Freight railcars leased to shippers and railroads; product sales: New and used freight railcars and replacement components; commissions or management fees: Management of railcars owned by third parties; service fees: Railcar maintenance and repair, shipment management and transloading
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Owns and manages freight railcar fleets leased to shippers and railroads; OEM / manufacturer: Fabricates railcars from steel and purchased components for shippers, railroads and fleet owners; service provider: Maintains railcars for fleet owners and coordinates rail shipments for shippers; software / platform: Turns rail shipment and fleet data into tracking and planning tools for shippers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Freight railcar leasing, manufacturing, fleet management, maintenance and logistics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and leasing teams working with shippers, railroads and fleet owners; own locations: Railcar maintenance and repair shops and transloading facilities; online: Web-based rail shipment and fleet management tools

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Railcar design, inspection and repair subject to FRA safety rules, AAR standards and hazardous-material tank car requirements

notes: The pricing model for rail logistics software is uncertain.
